name: fpl-quant-planner
description: Node-based unit tests for the browser-side JS -- planner/ (the multi-gameweek transfer planner's data/rules/solver modules) and the DOM-free renderers extracted from index.html (e.g. the 'Explain this' sheet). No dependencies -- uses Node's built-in test runner. The rest of this repo is a Python quant pipeline (see requirements.txt/pytest); this file exists only to give the browser JS the same kind of testable home.
